events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/kernel/sched/schedule_api/src/test_sched_timeslice_and_lock.c` where `test_sleep_cooperative` called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))`. Calling `k_yield()` left the cooperative main thread (priority -1) in the ready queue ahead of the lower-priority thread (`tdata[2]`, priority 0), preventing `tdata[2]` from executing and leaving un-aborted threads on assertion failure. With `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))`, the main thread is placed in the timeout queue, allowing all three spawned threads to execute and the full `schedule_api` test suite to pass on `qemu_riscv32`.", "kind": "FinishAction"}

events.observation: {"content": [{"cache_prompt": false, "type": "text", "text": "Fixed the defect in `tests/kernel/sched/schedule_api/src/test_sched_timeslice_and_lock.c` where `test_sleep_cooperative` called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(K_MSEC(100))`. Calling `k_yield()` left the cooperative main thread (priority -1) in the ready queue ahead of the lower-priority thread (`tdata[2]`, priority 0), preventing `tdata[2]` from executing and leaving un-aborted threads on assertion failure.
